name: Tomorrow Never Comes
source:
Welcome to the theology club.

We discuss different topics from religion to morality and everything in between.

Chiko made the club to open discourse.

I promise I'd never leave you.

So let's be friends forever.

[from [url=https://hilows.itch.io/tomorrow-never-comes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到神学俱乐部。

我们讨论从宗教到道德以及介于两者之间的一切话题。

智子让俱乐部公开讨论。

我保证我永远不会离开你。

所以让我们成为永远的朋友吧。

[来自[url=https://hilows.itch.io/tomorrow-never-comes]itch.io[/url]]
